name: adamantine
unidentified_descriptor: a midnight-dark blade that shows no edge wear
first_pickup_chronicle: Adamantine. The metal does not bend, does not chip, does not forgive. Every legendary smith dreams about this metal and dies without ever working a forge hot enough.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.70, weight_mult 1.30, no effective_against (T5 core, top raw damage). weight_mult 1.30 — HEAVY. The 'tank' material — unbreakable, immune to rust monsters / acid attacks (HUGE — rust monsters are a roguelike classic terror). armor_ac_bonus 2 — best in class. Fighter-class gear.
